manifest.name: Pomodoro Desk
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: A full productivity workspace with a built-in Pomodoro timer, session history, card-linked focus sessions, and break reminders

css: .pomodoro-desk-active { } .pomodoro-panel { position: fixed; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: 320px; background: #fff; border-top: 2px solid #e74c3c; border-left: 1px solid #ddd; box-shadow: -4px -2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); z-index: 9999; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 420px; } .pomodoro-panel-header { padding: 12px 16px; background: #e74c3c; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .pomodoro-panel-minimize { background: none; border: none; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; padding: 0 4px; } .pomodoro-timer-display { text-align: center; padding: 20px; } .pomodoro-time { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 300; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; color: #333; letter-spacing: 2px; } .pomodoro-time.break-time { color: #27ae60; } .pomodoro-status { font-size: 12px; color: #999; margin-top: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; } .pomodoro-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; padding: 0 16px 16px; } .pomodoro-btn { padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 20px; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .pomodoro-btn-start { background: #e74c3c; color: #fff; } .pomodoro-btn-start:hover { background: #c0392b; } .pomodoro-btn-pause { background: #f39c12; color: #fff; } .pomodoro-btn-pause:hover { background: #e67e22; } .pomodoro-btn-reset { background: #ecf0f1; color: #666; } .pomodoro-btn-reset:hover { background: #ddd; } .pomodoro-sessions { padding: 8px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #eee; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; } .pomodoro-sessions-title { font-size: 11px; color: #999; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .pomodoro-session-item { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; color: #666; border-bottom: 1px solid #f5f5f5; } .pomodoro-session-time { color: #999; } .pomodoro-today-stats { padding: 8px 16px; background: #fafafa; border-top: 1px solid #eee; font-size: 11px; color: #666; display: flex; justify-content: space-around; } .pomodoro-stat { text-align: center; } .pomodoro-stat-value { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #e74c3c; } .pomodoro-minimized { position: fixed; bottom: 10px; right: 10px; background: #e74c3c; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 24px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; z-index: 9999; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(231,76,60,0.3); display: none; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; } .pomodoro-minimized:hover { background: #c0392b; } body.dark-theme .pomodoro-panel { background: #1e1e2e; border-left-color: #333; } body.dark-theme .pomodoro-time { color: #eee; } body.dark-theme .pomodoro-sessions { border-top-color: #333; } body.dark-theme .pomodoro-session-item { border-bottom-color: #2a2a3a; color: #bbb; } body.dark-theme .pomodoro-today-stats { background: #16162a; border-top-color: #333; color: #aaa; } body.dark-theme .pomodoro-btn-reset { background: #2a2a3a; color: #bbb; }
